en-US.title: ImmichDrive
en-US.shortDescription: Browse your Immich photos and videos in File Explorer, with thumbnails and files that download on demand. Requires your own Immich server and API key.
en-US.fullDescription:
ImmichDrive brings your Immich photo and video library into Windows File Explorer as a native cloud drive. Browse your timeline, preview thumbnails, and attach photos from an app's file picker without manually exporting your library. Full files download on demand when you open them.

Browse by date, or use the Albums, Favorites, and Partners folders to find your photos. Background sync keeps the drive in step with changes on your server.

To add photos and videos, drop them into the Upload folder. The rest of the drive is a read-only mirror that protects your server library from local changes and deletions.

ImmichDrive runs in the system tray and connects to the Immich server you choose using your API key. Your library stays on your own server; no additional photo hosting service is required. Your API key is stored encrypted for your Windows account.

The app is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese. It follows your Windows display language unless you pick one in Settings.

Requirements: Windows 10 22H2 with updates from October 2024 or later, or Windows 11, access to an Immich server, and an Immich API key with the required permissions. An Immich server is not included. ImmichDrive is an independent, third-party client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Immich project.
